question.text: An appeal from a decision or order of the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT) lies to the Supreme Court of India and must be filed within:

answer.text: 30 days from communication of the SAT decision or order
45 days from communication of the SAT decision or order
60 days from communication of the SAT decision or order
90 days from communication of the SAT decision or order

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that an appeal from a decision or order of SAT to the Supreme Court must be filed within 60 days from communication of the SAT decision or order to the aggrieved person. The Trap: 45 days is the SAT appeal period (against SEBI/IRDAI/PFRDA orders), and the trigger there is receipt of the order. Mixing the two timelines, or anchoring the 60 days to the date of the SAT order rather than its communication, is the common error. Note: The appeal sequence is SEBI order → SAT (45 days from receipt of order) → Supreme Court (60 days from communication of SAT decision/order).
